casadas: casar — married, settled in marriage (past part. fem. pl.; tener por casadas 'to count themselves married'; = casadas)
cadió: caer — fell, fell to one's lot (preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal's ca[d]ió; = cayó)
gradeçedes: gradecer — you thank, are grateful for (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = agradecéis)
dígovos: dezir + vos — I tell you (present 1st sg. digo + enclitic vos; = os digo)
remanga: remanir (also remaner) — let it remain (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quede)
dond: dond — where (apocopated donde, Latin de unde; = donde)
pagadas: pagar — satisfied, content (past part. fem. pl.; = pagadas, closest contentas)
presentajas: presentaja — gift, present (fem. pl.; en presentajas 'as gifts'; = presentes, regalos)
díga: dezir — may he say (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = diga)
lievan: levar — they carry, take along (present 3rd pl., with the diphthong ie; = llevan)
besava: besar — he kissed, was kissing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = besaba)
enbiava: enbiar — he was sending (imperfect 3rd sg.; = enviaba)
ovisse: aver — I should have, he should have (imperfect subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., here 1st: mientra que ovisse el alma 'as long as I have the soul (in me)'; Pidal: a dialect form for oviesse; = hubiese, hubiera)
valladolid: Valladolid — Valladolid, the Castilian city (= Valladolid)
enviávale: enviar + le — he was sending him (imperfect 3rd sg. enviava + enclitic le, 'to him'; = le enviaba)
mandasse: mandar — he might order (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = mandase)
mensajes: mensaje — messenger, envoy; also message (pl.; estos mensajes 'these messengers'; = mensajeros, mensajes)
ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
carrion: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia (= Carrión)
is: i + se — there ... themselves (i, adverb 'there', Latin ibi, + reflexive se; = allí se)
açertaron: açertar(se) — they happened to be (present), chanced to be there (preterite 3rd pl.; with is = i se: is açertaron 'there happened to be'; = se hallaron, se encontraron)
garcia: García — García, a personal name (the count García of the poem, Garci Ordóñez; = García)
cuédanse: cuedar + se — they think, suppose (present 3rd pl. cuedan + enclitic se; cuedar = cuidar, 'to think'; = se creen, piensan)
seíse: seer + se — he was (imperfect 3rd sg. seíe, its final e lost before the enclitic se; seer + gerund = estar + gerund; the se goes with the gerund: seíse santiguando 'was crossing himself'; = se estaba santiguando)
santiguando: santiguar — crossing (oneself), making the sign of the cross (gerund; santiguarse; = santiguando)
firiéronse: ferir + se — they threw themselves down, dismounted (preterite 3rd pl. firieron + enclitic se; ferirse a tierra, Pidal 'echar pie a tierra', 'to get down to the ground'; = echaron pie a tierra)
diçieron: deçir — they went down, dismounted (preterite 3rd pl.; Pidal's di[ç]ieron; OS deçir, Latin descendere; = descendieron)
antel: ante + el — before the (preposition ante + article el; = ante el)
inoios: inojos — knees (masc. pl.; = hinojos; Pidal's spelling inoios)
fincados: fincar — planted, set down (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with inojos; los inojos fincados 'knees on the ground'; = hincados)
tienes: tener + se — he holds himself (present 3rd sg. tiene + reflexive se, the e of se run into tiene; tener por 'to consider as'; = se tiene)
yúceff: Yúceff — Yúsuf, the name of the Moorish king of Marruecos (= Yúsuf)
nombrado: nombrar — named, called (past part. masc. sg.; = nombrado)
venidos: venir — come, become (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; ricos son venidos 'have become rich'; = venidos)
embíavos: enbiar + vos — he sends you (present 3rd sg. enbía + enclitic vos; = os envía)
reçíbolos: recebir + los — I receive them (present 1st sg. reçibo + enclitic los; = los recibo)
enbiado: enbiar — sent (past part. masc. sg.; = enviado)
seremos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl.; = seremos)
abiltados: abiltar — shamed, dishonored (past part. masc. pl., from abiltar 'to dishonor', cf. vil; seremos abiltados 'we shall be dishonored'; = envilecidos)
biltadamientre: biltadamientre — easily, without effort (Pidal 'fácilmente, sin esfuerzo'); literally 'basely, cheaply', adverb in -mientre from the stem of abiltar, 'to debase' (= fácilmente)
fallasse: fallar — he might find (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = hallase)
aduzirse: aduzir + se — to bring away for oneself (infinitive + enclitic dative se; aduzirse los cavallos 'to carry off the horses for himself'; = aducir, closest traerse)
enbargo: enbargo — hindrance, trouble, harm (noun; aver enbargo 'to come to harm, be hindered'; = embargo, closest estorbo, daño)
mándovos: mandar + vos — I order you (present 1st sg. mando + enclitic vos; = os mando)
cuorpos: cuerpo — body (masc. pl., old diphthong uo; = cuerpos)
ondradamientre: ondradamientre — honorably, with honor (adverb in -mientre from ondrado; = honradamente)
guarnirvos: guarnir + vos — to equip you (infinitive + enclitic vos; guarnir 'to equip, outfit'; = guarneceros)
dixiéredes: dezir — you shall say (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; = dijereis, tense obsolete)
parescades: parecer — may you look, appear (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = parezcáis)
prendedlos: prender + los — take them! (imperative 2nd pl. prended + enclitic los; = prendedlos, closest tomadlos)
demandemos: demandar — let us ask for (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; = demandemos, closest pidamos)
vinien: venir — they were coming, came (imperfect 3rd pl.; = venían)
garcía: García — García, a personal name (the count García of the poem, Garci Ordóñez; = García)

__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
__broaden__.d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings')
__broaden__.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado) · also ganados — gains, spoils (noun, masc. pl.; Pidal 'ganancias': los ganados que fizo 'the gains he made'; = ganancias)
__broaden__.parte: parte — part, side (de parte de los moros 'on the Moors' side'; = parte) · also partir (se) — he parts, leaves (present 3rd sg. of partir, with non se le: que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'; = se aparta) · also partir — it divides, separates (present 3rd sg., transitive; la sierra, que las otras tierras parte 'the sierra that divides the other lands'; = separa)
__broaden__.manda: mandar — he orders (present 3rd sg.; manda echar 'orders (them) put out'; = manda) · also mandar — he rules, governs (of a place; del que Valençia manda 'of him who rules Valencia'; = gobierna)
__broaden__.ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
__broaden__.reyno: reyno — kingdom (= reino) · also reyno — reign (Pidal: mio reyno adelant 'en lo sucesivo de mi reinado', 'in the rest of my reign'; = reinado)
__broaden__.adelant: adelant — onward, ahead (apocopated adverb; = adelante) · also adelant — henceforth, from now on (of time; mio reyno adelant 'the rest of my reign'); ir adelant 'to prosper, go forward' (las nuevas del Çid mucho van adelant; = prosperar)
__broaden__.conssejo: conssejo — help, remedy (spelling variant of consejo; Pidal 'amparo, socorro'; = consejo) · also conssejo — council, deliberation (fablando en so conssejo 'talking in their council'; = consejo)
__broaden__.passada: passar — passed, gone (past part. fem. sg. with ser, agreeing with noche; Passada es la noche 'the night is past'; = pasada) · also passar — crossed (past part. fem. sg. with aver, agreeing with its object; passada han la sierra 'they have crossed the sierra'; = han pasado)
__broaden__.arrancada: arrancada — rout, headlong flight; also the pursuit and rout of the enemy (de arrancada 'in rout'; el arrancada, el before a vowel-initial fem. noun; = arrancada) · also 'victory' (Pidal's gloss at v. 1233: esta arrancada 'this victory') · also arrancar — won (past part. fem. sg. with aver, agreeing with lid: desta lid que mio Çid ha arrancada 'this battle my Çid has won'; = ganada)
__broaden__.arrancado: arrancado — routed, driven off (past part. of arrancar, 'to pull out, uproot', here 'to rout'; arrancado es el rey 'the king is routed'; = arrancado, derrotado) · also arrancar — won (of a battle; una lid a arrancado 'he has won a battle'; = ganado)
__broaden__.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese)
__broaden__.poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence' · also poridad — secret council, secret plan (aviendo su poridad 'holding their secret talk'; con esta poridad 'with this secret plan')
__broaden__.tienen: tener — they have, hold, carry (present 3rd pl.; todas tienen pendones 'all carry pennons'; = tienen) · also tenerse por — to count oneself (ques tienen por casadas 'who count themselves married'; = se tienen por)
__broaden__.gradéscolo: gradecer + lo — I thank (God) for it (present 1st sg. gradesco + enclitic lo; = lo agradezco) · also gradéscolo a — I thank (someone) for it (Gradéscolo a mio Çid 'I thank my Çid for it')
__broaden__.abrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán); abrán a far 'they will have to do' · also abrán de + inf. 'will have to, are bound to' (a bien abrán de venir 'will come to good'; = habrán de)
